text: anika: Hey team — customer on Private (vpc) report: collector failing to upload debug bundle to presigned S3, intermittent 403s. Happens ~20-30m after bundle created. collector v1.12.3. Request IDs I have: req-0a1b2c3d,repro-req-5f6e7d8c. Need repro steps. jules: Thanks — can you paste the exact curl you ran and the collector logs around the upload? also bundle id if you have it. anika: bundle id: dbg-2026-0317-42. here's the curl I used to reproduce (presigned PUT): ``` curl -v -T bundle-dbg-2026-0317-42.tar.gz "https://redwood-presign.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/...?X-Amz-Signature=..." -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" ``` Response headers show 403 and body: ``` < HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden < x-amz-request-id: AFKJ1234EXAMPLE < x-amz-id-2: 1a2b3c4d5e < Content-Type: application/xml AccessDenied Access Denied ``` collector-bot: [2026-03-17T15:12:23Z] upload_start: bundle=dbg-2026-0317-42, url_expiry=3600s collector-bot: [2026-03-17T15:38:07Z] upload_failed: http_status=403, s3_req=A1B2C3D4 carlos: A few quick checks: 1) system clock on collector (date -R), 2) presign TTL and generation time, 3) any intermediate proxy altering headers. Can you run `date -R` and paste output? Also does the collector retry and get different URL? anika: date -R on host: `Tue, 17 Mar 2026 15:38:05 +0000` (looks ok). presign TTL from controlplane: 3600s, generated at 14:41:53Z, used at 15:12Z and failing at 15:38Z. No proxy in front of collector (direct egress). carlos: clock looks fine. Another common culprit for our private debug flow: signed manifest/redaction mismatch or missing metadata headers on PUT. Do you have the collector manifest and the signed manifest hash? `sudo cat /var/lib/redwood/collector/manifest.sig` anika: grabbing manifest now, will redact sensitive fields before posting. jen: (eng-infra) FYI we've seen presign rotation bug when KMS-encrypted manifests are present — the presign service needs the header `x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms` preserved by the client. If the collector strips that header on retry, S3 will reject. Also check whether the presign URL was generated for POST vs PUT (we recently defaulted to PUT for bundles). mika: security note — please run collector with `--redact=full` before attaching logs to Slack. do not paste PII. anika: I ran the reproduce flow with full debug and redact=full. here's the exact collect + upload snippet I'm going to run locally to reproduce and capture verbose output: ``` sudo /usr/local/bin/collector --collect --bundle-name dbg-2026-0317-42 --out /tmp/dbg-2026-0317-42.tar.gz --redact=full --log-level debug # then curl -v -T /tmp/dbg-2026-0317-42.tar.gz "" -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" -H "x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms" --stderr /tmp/curl-verbose.txt ``` I attached (redacted) /tmp/curl-verbose.txt which shows 403 and included server response id AFKJ1234EXAMPLE. jules: Good. Two more sanity checks: compute sha256 of the local bundle and compare to the manifest's checksum we send in the signed manifest. Command: `sha256sum /tmp/dbg-*.tar.gz` and `rdx-checksum /tmp/dbg-*.tar.gz` (our helper prints expected vs actual). If they differ, redaction stage might have run twice or truncated stream during tar. Also include the collector debug log lines around `redact` and `signed-manifest upload`. anika: Ran rdx-checksum -> output: `expected: a3f5d2... actual: a3f5d2...` (they match). But our collector log shows: ``` [2026-03-17T15:11:30Z] redact: started, profile=full [2026-03-17T15:12:01Z] redact: finished, bytes_in=12593045, bytes_out=12593040 [2026-03-17T15:12:02Z] signed_manifest: generating sha256= a3f5d2... [2026-03-17T15:12:03Z] upload: presign requested, ttl=3600 [2026-03-17T15:12:23Z] upload: put started [2026-03-17T15:38:07Z] upload: put failed 403 AccessDenied ``` Note bytes_out is 5 bytes smaller than bytes_in — maybe tar header change? carlos: Ah — that delta could be due to a gzip header timestamp or tar deterministic header difference between when manifest checksum was calculated vs final stream. We recently added a change that calculates the checksum before finalizing the gzip container which can mismatch if mtime is included. Workaround: run collector with `--deterministic-archive` or set `TZ=UTC` and `--tar-mtime 0` to make the archive deterministic for checksum + signed-manifest. Can you try `--deterministic-archive` and regenerate presign/upload? anika: trying now. running collector with `--deterministic-archive --redact=full` and then curl. I'll paste results. collector-bot: [2026-03-17T16:02:11Z] collect_complete: bundle=dbg-2026-0317-42-d1, checksum=a3f5d25b... collector-bot: [2026-03-17T16:02:34Z] upload_start: bundle=dbg-2026-0317-42-d1, url_expiry=3600s collector-bot: [2026-03-17T16:28:47Z] upload_failed: http_status=403, s3_req=Z9Y8X7W6 jen: If deterministic archive fixes local checksum but upload still 403, capture the exact PUT request headers from curl verbose and compare to the presign service expectation. Sometimes our presign includes `x-amz-meta-redaction: full` and the client must send that metadata or S3 rejects. curl `-v` shows headers sent. anika: curl -v output (redacted headers): ``` > PUT /... HTTP/1.1 > Host: redwood-presign.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com > User-Agent: curl/7.88.1 > Accept: */* > Content-Type: application/gzip > x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms > Content-Length: 12593040 > Expect: 100-continue ``` Presign expectation (from control plane debug): required_headers = ["content-type","x-amz-server-side-encryption","x-amz-meta-redaction"] carlos: Bingo — the client didn't include `x-amz-meta-redaction`. We need that header present on PUT. Either collector must preserve metadata headers on upload, or presign should not require that metadata. For immediate repro, add `-H "x-amz-meta-redaction: full"` to your curl. anika: added header and retried — success! 200 OK. Reproducer curl now shows 200. jules: OK this means root cause: presign required metadata header but collector didn't attach it on streaming PUT (edge case on retries where metadata lost). For fix: 1) short-term customer workaround: ensure collector v1.12.3 is started with env var `REDWOOD_COLLECTOR_PRESERVE_METADATA=true` and/or upgrade to v1.13 where we fixed header preservation. 2) infra: we should relax presign header requirement or validate at presign time whether header is actually necessary for S3. 3) eng: add an integration test covering retries with metadata. jen: Filed infra ticket INFRA-4312 to add presign tolerance and log mismatch. Also adding a metric for `upload_header_mismatch`. mika: Confirmed no PII was leaked in logs shared. Once customer upgrades or we patch, we can close. Also recommend we rotate the presign keys used for that batch if there's concern (but not necessary for AccessDenied). anika: I'll coordinate with customer, send the workaround and steps: regenerate bundle with `--deterministic-archive` or set env, or just upgrade to v1.13. thanks all :thumbsup: jules: closing loop — please paste customer's final confirmation here when they verify.
